messages:
anna_prodeng: Hi team, Evergreen Analytics' Dedicated slice is ready for switchover. Proposed window: Tue 2026-04-05 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need signoff on rollback thresholds (fail rate >3% or p95 latency >1200ms) and model pin to v2.3.1. Can ops + releases ack?

mike_release: ack on window. Can we tighten p95 to 1000ms? Last canary hit ~980ms but that was with cold cache.

sara_ops: ops 👍 02:00 UTC works. We'll have extra oncall for +2h. Rollback threshold OK at 3% unless we see a sharp error spike. Recommend enabling automatic fallback to cpu-quantized variant as safety.

tian_engineering: noted. We'll pin model to `redwood-model-2.3.1` and configure fallback route to `redwood-model-2.2.9-quant`. Will add the pin to the deployment manifest.

julia_pm: Release notes draft uploaded to docs, added customer contacts. https://docs.internal/release/evergreen-2026-04 — please add any callouts.

deploy-bot: Deployment job queued: job_id=deploy-1798884321-evg. Planned start=2026-04-05T02:00:00Z. Estimated duration 30m. Canary slice: evg-canary-01.

mike_release: small ask — enable `prefix_cache=true` for this tenant to reduce token spend. ops ok?

sara_ops: yes, enable it. Ops will watch cache hit rate and memory pressure.

anna_prodeng: final checklist:
- model pin -> redwood-model-2.3.1
- automatic fallback -> redwood-model-2.2.9-quant
- rollback triggers -> >3% errors OR p95 > 1000ms sustained for 5m
- prefix_cache = true
- oncall coverage until +2h after window
If no objections I will mark go at 18:00 UTC today.

mike_release: go for me :ship:

tian_engineering: go

sara_ops: go :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started: job_id=deploy-1798884321-evg-1

deploy-bot: canary pass at +18m, metrics: errors=0.2%, p95=520ms, cpu=42%, cache_hit=78% — looks healthy, cost per 1k tokens down ~12%

anna_prodeng: excellent. Promoting to full slice in 10m.

deploy-bot: full promotion complete. job_id=deploy-1798884321-evg-1. Rollout status: SUCCESS

julia_pm: Noting release complete and emailing customer contacts. Will attach CI logs and the rollback command in the follow-up.

anna_prodeng: thanks all — saving this thread for the customer handoff and postmortem if needed.
